heading.title: Conditions Requisite for Initiation of Proceedings

article.title: Additional Sessions Judges to try cases made over to them
article.content: An Additional Sessions Judge shall try such cases as the Sessions Judge of the division may, by general or special order, make over to him for trial or as the High Court may, by special order, direct him to try.
article.html:
214Additional Sessions Judges to try cases made over to them

Section 214 · Chapter XV

An Additional Sessions Judge shall try such cases as the Sessions Judge of the division may, by general or special order, make over to him for trial or as the High Court may, by special order, direct him to try.
